h1: Wellness at Home: A Softer Start to the Year
intro: Eight pieces for the part of January that is not about doing more. Light that comes up gradually, weight on the body at night, a kettle worth leaving on the counter. These are the small, quiet things that make a home feel restful, and every one of them earns its place on a shelf you look at every day.
seo_title: Wellness at Home: Sleep and Calm for a Softer New Year
seo_description: Eight wellness pieces for a calmer home: a diffuser, a weighted blanket, a sunrise alarm and a silk sleep mask, verified picks from Evergreen House.
list_card_line: Eight quiet pieces for the part of January that is not about doing more.

cards.B0F999PHLV: A ceramic diffuser that runs for hours and looks like it belongs on the shelf.
cards.B09S2ZGMKZ: Weight without the heat, for the people who wake up too warm at three in the morning.
cards.B081CHLF46: A light that comes up like a sunrise instead of a phone alarm at six.
cards.B0095FFUM4: A dotted notebook that lays flat, for the lists and the pages you mean to keep.
cards.B000I68NCS: A steel basket that brews loose tea and coffee, so the bags stop going in the bin.
cards.B08PP48979: A kettle that heats in minutes and looks good enough to leave out on the counter.
cards.B00S5Q826U: Silk over the eyes that blocks the light without pressing on the lashes.
cards.B0C2C9NHZW: A humidifier that fills from the top and runs quiet through the night.
